trainer.title: Designed For
trainer.descr: I played for Grasshopper Club Zürich for seven years, progressing through the youth ranks from the U15 to the U21 level. My goal was to become a professional footballer. Looking back, I am convinced that I failed to make the final step into professional football partly due to a lack of athleticism. This experience is the driving force behind AFT Performance. Today, my aim is to help young football athletes—as well as ambitious adults and, in the long run, elite and professional players—become faster, more explosive, and higher-performing. I am an Elite Athlete Performance Coach.
trainer.athleticind.text: Individually tailored athletic training sessions that specifically target speed, explosiveness, strength, and mobility. The training is adapted to the athlete's personal goals and current performance level.
trainer.group.text: Professional athletic training in small groups, focusing on speed, explosiveness, strength, and endurance. The sessions are specifically tailored to soccer players and ambitious athletes across various age groups and performance levels.
trainer.online.text: Personalized support regardless of location, featuring tailored training plans, regular communication, and professional guidance. The training can be flexibly integrated into your daily routine and continuously adjusted.
trainer.digital.text: Structured training programs that are available online at any time and can be completed independently. The programs offer clear training plans and exercises for athletes who want to specifically improve their performance.

about.descr: I played for Grasshopper Club Zürich for seven years, progressing through the youth ranks from the U15 to the U21 level. My goal was professional football, but looking back, I lacked—among other things—the athleticism required to make that final step. That experience shaped AFT Performance. Today, I use my expertise as an Elite Athlete Performance Coach to help young footballers and ambitious athletes become faster, more explosive, and higher-performing.
about.vision.title: Our Vision
about.vision.descr: Our vision is to provide targeted support to athletes, helping them unlock their full physical potential and achieve sustainable improvements in their athletic performance. Through professional athletic training, personalized guidance, and modern training concepts, we aim to take athletes to the next level—from young prospects to ambitious adults.
about.efficiency.descr: Effective athletic training with a clear goal: better performance in less time. Each training session focuses on the skills that are truly crucial for the individual athlete.
about.convience.descr: Training should be easy to integrate into everyday life. Through online booking, flexible training options, and future digital programs, we provide straightforward access to professional athletic training.
about.personilation.descr: Every athlete is different. That is why training content and workloads are tailored to age, performance level, goals, and individual needs—for targeted and sustainable development.
